newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Martinair starts Indonesia cargo service.
newsitem.headline: Martinair starts Indonesia cargo service.

text.p: Martinair, the Dutch cargo and charter airline, on Tuesday began a regular air cargo service between Amsterdam and Jakarta in a joint operation with flag carrier Garuda Indonesia, a Garuda official said.

Garuda business director Soedarso Kaderi said in a speech that the two airlines signed an agreement for the joint operation at Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport after the arrival of the first flight from Amsterdam.
"This Jakarta-Amsterdam cargo flight will use a Boeing 747-200 aircraft with one scheduled flight a week, departing from Jakarta every Tuesday," Kaderi said.
Kaderi said the route could carry foodstuffs, raw materials, chemical products, drinks, tobacco and other industrial products.
"It is hoped that the joint operation will raise the cargo load factor and overcome the limited air cargo space to Europe which until has been a source of complaint," he said.
